svg.aria-label: JEJ Notional Machine — Machine at a Glance. Source code at top feeds a scope chain (realm → script → block). The realm splits into ECMA intrinsics and host bindings. Two chain lookups: scope chain finds variables; prototype chain finds methods. I/O routes through host bindings to dev console and user dialogs.

source → behind-the-scenes evaluation model → host I/O channels

g.text: A string. Three audiences read it differently:
developers (intent) · the NM (parses + evaluates) · users (experience effects)
Agents (LLMs) collaborate on it — see syllabus / README for the four-audience model.

svg.text: Visual-syntax level — what the code says
Behind-the-scenes — what the NM does invisibly

g.text: Scope chain — bindings live here, walked top → bottom by name resolution
🌍 Realm — global environment (top of scope chain)
"the world your script is born into" · static, host-installed before any user code runs
ctor: new Date() ← sole `new` in JEJ
Plus RegExp.prototype (.test) — found via proto chain on regex literals.
No globalThis, no RegExp constructor, no isNaN/isFinite at top level — use Number.isNaN / Number.isFinite.
During creation: each binding is reserved with status='tdz'.
During evaluation: each binding's declaration line transitions tdz → initialized.
Block scope (lazy — pushed on entry, popped on exit)
created by BlockDeclarationInstantiation (§14.2.3) · only when the block has lexical decls
scope:push event fires on entry · scope:pop event fires on exit (reason: normal/break/…)
Empty / no-decl blocks elide their env per spec — no events fire.
Scope chain — variable lookup: block → script → realm. Resolves identifier to a binding.
Prototype chain — method lookup: value → Constructor.prototype. Resolves property to a method.
Each chain step is observable as scopeChainWalk / protoChainWalk on resolve events. A miss-chain ending at the top → ReferenceError (scope) or undefined (proto).
user sees: message + text field + OK/Cancel
if either is String → ToString×2 → concat
postfix x++ returns OLD; prefix ++x returns NEW
Legend: ━━ scope chain · - - proto chain · ━━ I/O routing · key = realm binding name · ƒ = callable function value
See notional-machine.md for prose model and spec correspondence (ECMA-262 §-numbers).
